overview.purpose_zh: 把一座城市几种通勤方式按占比从高到低排开，用点和细线代替柱子，看排名和头尾差距；项目一多，比一排柱子更清爽。
works_zh: 项目较多时的排名比较
一眼看出第一名领先多少
需要清爽版面的报告角落
uses_zh: 城市出行调查的结论页
渠道或方式占比的汇报

understanding.read_zh: 从上往下读，排在最上面的是占比最高的方式。点落在横轴的哪个位置，就代表哪个百分比；细线只是把点连回基线，帮助你顺着同一列看。

elements.note_zh: 每个点代表一种通勤方式的占比，位置对应横轴数值。
从基线连到圆点的细线，只起引导作用，不表示额外数值。
占比百分比，从零开始，点越靠右数值越大。
已经按占比从高到低排好，从上往下就是名次。

look_for_zh: 第一名领先第二名多少
中间几项是不是挨得很近
最后一名低到什么程度
有没有哪一项明显断层

observations.en: Metro is the most common way to work, at 38 percent, followed by Bus at 21.
observations.zh: 地铁是最常见的通勤方式，占 38%，其次是公交的 21%。

observations.en: The gap between Metro and Bus is 17 points, wider than any gap between neighbouring modes.
observations.zh: 地铁和公交之间相差 17 个百分点，比榜单上其他相邻两项之间的差距都大。

observations.en: Car follows at 18 percent, only 3 points behind Bus.
observations.zh: 汽车以 18% 排在第三，只比公交低 3 个百分点。

observations.en: Bike, Walk and Other fill the bottom three places at 12, 8 and 3 percent.
observations.zh: 自行车、步行和其他排在最后三位，分别占 12%、8% 和 3%。

observations.en: Metro's 38 percent is nearly twice Bus's 21 percent.
observations.zh: 地铁的 38% 接近公交 21% 的两倍。

describe.en: Metro accounts for 38 percent of commuters, the largest share.
describe.zh: 地铁占全部通勤者的 38%，是最大的份额。
describe.pattern: X accounts for + percentage + of + whole
alternatives: Metro accounts for 38 percent of all commuters.
Metro makes up 38 percent of the total, more than any other mode.
describe.note_zh: account for 后面要接「百分比 + of + 整体」，of 不能省。

describe.en: Metro holds the largest share of commuters at 38 percent.
describe.zh: 地铁在通勤者中占比最大，为 38%。
describe.pattern: X has / holds / takes the largest share of + whole
alternatives: Metro takes the largest share of commuters, at 38 percent.
The largest share of commuters, 38 percent, goes to Metro.
describe.note_zh: the largest share 说的是占比最大，这里全部方式合计是 100%，用起来正合适。

describe.en: Bus is second at 21 percent, closely followed by Car at 18.
describe.zh: 公交以 21% 排在第二，汽车以 18% 紧随其后。
describe.pattern: A + lead + closely followed by + B
alternatives: Bus comes second at 21 percent, with Car close behind at 18.
After Bus at 21 percent, Car follows at 18.
describe.note_zh: closely 适合 3 个百分点这种小差距；地铁和公交差 17 个百分点，就不加 closely。

describe.en: Metro's share is higher than that of Bus, at 38 percent against 21.
describe.zh: 地铁的份额高于公交，为 38% 对 21%。
alternatives: Metro is higher than Bus, 38 percent against 21.
Metro's 38 percent is higher than Bus's 21 percent.
describe.note_zh: 比较份额时用 that of 指代前一个名词，避免把份额和交通方式本身相比。

describe.en: Bus, Car and Bike recorded 21, 18 and 12 percent respectively.
describe.zh: 公交、汽车和自行车分别为 21%、18% 和 12%。
describe.pattern: A and B + verb + X and Y + respectively
alternatives: Bus, Car and Bike were at 21, 18 and 12 percent in that order.
The three middle modes took 21, 18 and 12 percent respectively.
describe.note_zh: respectively 按前面的顺序一一对应，先说公交就先给公交的数字。

describe.en: The five modes below Metro range between 3 and 21 percent.
describe.zh: 地铁以下的五种方式占比在 3% 到 21% 之间。
alternatives: Apart from Metro, the modes range from 3 to 21 percent.
All modes other than Metro sit between 3 and 21 percent.
describe.note_zh: 报区间用 between ... and ...，and 不能换成 to。

describe.en: What stands out is how far Metro leads: 38 percent against 21 for Bus.
describe.zh: 最突出的是地铁领先幅度之大：38% 对公交的 21%。
describe.pattern: What stands out is + noun phrase
alternatives: What stands out is the 17-point gap between Metro and Bus.
The most striking point is Metro's clear lead over every other mode.
describe.note_zh: what-stands-out 适合放在第一句，先把最想让人记住的点抛出来。

academic.en: The lollipop chart ranks six modes of commuting by their share of commuters. Metro occupies the first position at 38 percent, with Bus at 21 and Car at 18. Bike accounts for 12 percent, Walk for 8 and Other for 3. The difference between Metro and Bus, measured at 17 percentage points, exceeds every other adjacent gap in the ranking, whereas Bus and Car are separated by only 3 points. Since the dots are ordered, the figure is read as a ranking rather than a time series, and the six shares sum to 100 percent.
academic.zh: 这张棒棒糖图按通勤者占比给六种上班方式排序。地铁排第一，占 38%；公交是 21%，汽车是 18%。自行车占 12%，步行占 8%，其他占 3%。地铁与公交的差距为 17 个百分点，比榜单中其他相邻差距都大，而公交和汽车只差 3 个百分点。由于点是排序过的，这张图读的是名次，不是时间变化；六种方式的占比合计为 100%。

business.en: Metro is the backbone of our city's transport picture at 38 percent: more than a third of all commuters, and nearly twice Bus at 21 percent. Bus and Car are close, at 21 and 18 percent. Bike at 12 percent and Walk at 8 percent show a small but steady group of active commuters, while Other is just 3 percent. We should put our capacity into Metro first and treat Bus and Car as roughly equal demand.
business.zh: 地铁是我们城市交通的基本盘，占 38%：超过三分之一的上班族，几乎是公交 21% 的两倍。公交和汽车很接近，分别是 21% 和 18%。自行车 12%、步行 8%，说明有一小群稳定的绿色通勤者，其他方式只有 3%。我们应该先把运力投到地铁，公交和汽车按差不多的需求对待。

simple.en: Most people ride the Metro to work. That is 38 percent. Bus is next at 21 percent, and Car is right behind at 18. Bike has 12 percent, Walk has 8, and Other has 3. The Metro share is nearly twice the Bus share. All six ways of getting to work add up to 100 percent.
simple.zh: 大多数人坐地铁上班，占 38%。公交排第二，是 21%，汽车紧随其后，是 18%。自行车有 12%，步行有 8%，其他有 3%。地铁的份额差不多是公交的两倍。六种上班方式加起来正好是 100%。

language_notes.body_zh: 说占比用 account for 时，后面必须跟「百分比 + of + 整体」。这张图的整体是全部通勤者，所以说 accounts for 38 percent of commuters，不能省掉 of。
examples: Metro accounts for 38 percent of commuters.
Bus accounts for 21 percent of commuters.

language_notes.body_zh: 正好两倍用 twice；只是接近两倍就加 nearly。地铁 38% 对公交 21%，接近两倍但不是正好两倍，所以写 nearly twice，不写 twice。
examples: Metro's share is nearly twice Bus's share.
Bus is at 21 percent, so twice that would be just above Metro's 38.

language_notes.body_zh: 排好序的图用 rank first、come second、follow 来说名次；followed by 引出下一名，respectively 用来把几个名次和数字按顺序配对。
examples: Bus comes second at 21 percent, followed by Car at 18.
